notes.title: Update - v1.2.0
notes.content:
Update - v1.2.0
- [added] visual cue for event combat chance
- [added] avg. popularity to the turn report
- [changed] scout will take coins instead of food
- [changed] watchtower button sprite to make it more intutive
- [increased] lazaret effectivity from 10 to 20 percent
- [increased] first quest event reward
- [fixed] scout information for scripted attacks
- [fixed] popularity calculation for cloud save games
- [fixed] negative amounts of armor
- [fixed] some spelling errors
